source.figure: Main text, Raman paragraph and Fig. 1a (4 K, 2.07 eV spectrum with six WS2 peaks plus Si 520); peak positions LA 174, 2ZA 294, 2LA 349, E' 356, A1' 417, 479 cm-1

notes: Resonance Raman spectrum, excitation 613.82 nm (2.020 eV), 295 K, efficiency-corrected, WS2 PL background present, raw intensities. Positions are those stated for the 4 K 2.07 eV spectrum of Fig. 1a; the paper says peak centres are independent of excitation energy. 2LA(M) (349) and E' (356) overlap and may appear as one band; relative intensities change strongly with excitation energy near resonance. The paper also reports defect-activated LA at 174, 2ZA at 294 and Si 520 (substrate) in the 4 K 2.07 eV spectrum; these are not clearly resolved above noise in this exported column and are deliberately left out of peaks. Paper states 'monolayer'; polytype/space group not stated in the paper so left null.
